alternatives.argument: The carrier proves the exact inequality directly: Lipschitz continuity of g and the dense state error bound give |h(tauhat)|≤Lg eta+epsilon; the mean value theorem and sigma h′≥nu between tau and tauhat give |tauhat−tau|≤(Lg eta+epsilon)/nu, with equality tauhat=tau handled separately. The independent Esposito paper provides event-location context; it is not used as proof of the inequality.

The carrier proves the event-aligned finite recurrence: local residual radius plus exp(LH) times the start-state discrepancy bounds the incoming reference-mode error; the transverse lemma bounds event lag; the reset lemma, including the M+ lag term, propagates the next aligned state error. Finite induction covers all matched events and the terminal segment. The proof is independent of Shampine–Thompson.
